points: There were giants in the earth in those days; and also after that, when the sons of God came in unto the daughters of men, and they bare children to them, the same became mighty men which were of old, men of renown. These men became renowned and mighty, but also extremely wicked: powerful hybrid babies, pretty much, but wicked. The renowned part is the fame and the power, but the mighty part goes into the wickedness they were doing. That's why it called Nimrod a mighty hunter before the Lord. They were powerful, fierce, renowned fighters, but they were wicked as hell, cuz they intermingled with Cain.

note.label: As in the Days of Noah: Past & Present

points: There were giants in the earth in those days: because the sons of God, who had that DNA from being made in the image of God, took wives of the other nations, which was forbidden. The same became mighty men which were of old, men of renown. Remember that phrase, of old; Jude uses the same words.

note.label: Popular Persuasions: Fighting Against Heaven Defending Earth

points: The sons of God came in unto the daughters of men, and the same became mighty men which were of old, men of renown. That God spark created children that were renowned, powerful men on the earth, battling the giants.
The giants in the earth came from the sons of God intermingling with the other nations, and the children born to them became mighty men of renown.
